content: मदन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [माद्यति अनेन, मद्-करणे ल्युट्] .²1 Intoxicating, maddening. .²2 Delighting, exhilarating. .{@-नः@} .²1 The god of love, Cupid; व्यापाररोधि मदनस्य निषेवितव्यम् <ls>Ś. 1. 27</ls>; हतमपि निहन्त्येव मदनः <ls>Bh. 3. 18</ls>. .²2 Love, passion, sexual love, lust; विनयवारितवृत्तिरतस्तया न विवृतो मदनो न च संवृतः <ls>Ś. 2. 11</ls>; सतन्त्रिगीतं मदनस्य दीपकम् <ls>Ṛs. 1. 3</ls>; <ls>R. 5. 63</ls>; so मदनातुर, मदनपीडित <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 The spring season. .²4 A bee. .²5 Beesʼ-wax. .²6 A kind of embrace. .²7 The Dhattūra plant. .²8 The Khadira tree. .²9 The Bakula tree. .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of the 7th mansion (in <ab>astrol.</ab>). .²11 A kind of measure (in music). .{@-ना, -नी@} .²1 Spirituous liquor. .²2 Musk. .²3 The {%atimukta%} creeper. (नी only in these two senses). .{@-नम्@} .²1 Intoxicating. .²2 Gladdening, delighting.
